articles.title: Democrats Win Control of Congress
articles.summary: Democrats won the House and the Senate in the midterm elections, so Congress will check President Trump's work much more closely in his final two years.

articles.title: Nine States Elect History-Making Governors
articles.summary: Nine states elected governors who are firsts — including the first Black woman governor and the first Native American woman governor in U.S. history.

articles.title: A Former Teacher Wins a Big Senate Race in Texas
articles.summary: Former teacher James Talarico beat Ken Paxton in Texas, becoming the first Democrat to win a Senate seat there since 1988 — in the most expensive Senate race ever.
